name: aoi
title: Art of Intelligence: the Pipeline theme with the horizon wipe
description: The Pipeline AI Talks music ("Stank"), cut to the cards exactly as the pipeline style does, with Day One AI's Art of Intelligence horizon wipe at every join: a glowing band rises up the frame over the new shot. Pair it with --theme aoi for the brand's cards, captions and labels. The wipe is drawn in code and overlaps each join by 0.6 s, as a dissolve does.
